scenes.heading: The Message at Midnight
scenes.label: MIDNIGHT · MAYA'S APARTMENT
scenes.narration: At midnight, Maya received a message from her own number. Four words: Don't open the door.

speechParts.text: At midnight, Maya received a message from her own number.
Four words: Don't open the door.

scenes.heading: Then came the knock
scenes.label: THE DOOR STAYED CLOSED
scenes.narration: Three knocks. Maya reached for the lock. Her phone lit up again. This time, it was a photograph.

speechParts.text: This time, it was a photograph.

scenes.heading: Her hallway. Right now.
scenes.label: THE SAME CROOKED FRAME
scenes.narration: Her hallway. The crooked picture. The blue slipper she had just dropped. Whoever sent it was already inside.

speechParts.text: The blue slipper she had just dropped.
Whoever sent it was already inside.

scenes.heading: You opened it last time.
scenes.label: ANOTHER MESSAGE
scenes.narration: Then came the final message. You opened it last time. The clock flickered backward. Maya finally understood the warning.

scenes.heading: This time, she listened
scenes.label: ORIGINAL FICTION
scenes.narration: She left the lock untouched. Midnight returned. Her own warning appeared again. This time, the knocking stopped. Would you open it?
